# Admissions Guide
At ISPH we open the admissions throughout the year.
There is no specific time for admissions, however, we do have some year groups that have reached the full capacity, so please contact our Admissions Team to find out the availability.

### Step 1: Application
To begin enrolment, complete the application form online at isph.openapply.com and upload the required supporting documentation.
Read and Sign off Terms and conditions governing enrollment and admissions, (also available in Vietnamese).
### Step 2: Admissions Assessment
Next, we will contact you to arrange the Admissions Assessment.
During this session the Principal, Head of Primary or Head of Secondary will meet you and your child to discuss your application.
Your child will then complete various assessment tasks.
### Step 3: Offer of school place
Following successful completion of steps 1 & 2, a school place can then be offered, subject to availability.
Parents receive an Offer Letter, usually within two days.
If an offer cannot be made, we will explain.
### Step 4: Acceptance and Registration
To accept the offer of a place and complete your child’s registration at ISPH:
1. Sign & return: (a) Offer Letter
(b) Make payment of the Registration Fee
2. Registration completed.
A school place is reserved at ISPH.
### Step 5: Payment of fees & deposit
Before the child’s commencement at the school, parents will pay all other applicable fees; for example the tuition fee, capital fee and security deposit.

## About the school
### Admissions and fees
Applications are open throughout the year, and families can apply online with supporting documents.
The admissions process includes a meeting with a school leader and assessment tasks for the child.
Places are offered subject to availability; some year groups may be full.
After an offer, families accept the place and complete registration, then pay the applicable tuition and other enrolment fees before the student starts.
The 2026–27 fee schedule lists annual tuition from VND 211,565,750 for Nursery and Reception to VND 691,541,000 for Years 12 and 13.
...
## Admissions & academic calendar
Applications are made online with supporting documents, followed by a meeting with the Principal or Head of Primary/Secondary and assessment tasks.
An offer letter usually follows within two days; the place is secured by signing it and paying the registration fee.
Admissions are open throughout the year, subject to availability.
## Annual fees
For 2026-27, the discounted whole-year tuition is VND 211,565,750 for Nursery (age 3) and VND 691,541,000 for Year 13 (age 17).
The school also lists a three-term payment option (40%, 30%, 30%), totaling VND 232,714,000 for Nursery and VND 760,770,000 for Year 13.

content.text:
## Admissions process

ISPH accepts applications **throughout the year**, subject to places being available in the relevant year group.

1. **Apply online** through [ISPH’s application portal](https://isph.openapply.com) and upload the requested supporting documents; review and sign the admissions terms.
2. **Assessment:** The school arranges a meeting with you and your child, usually with a senior school leader, plus age-appropriate assessment tasks.
3. **Offer:** If the assessment is successful and a place is available, ISPH issues an Offer Letter—typically within about two days.
4. **Accept and register:** Sign and return the Offer Letter and pay the registration fee to secure the place.
5. **Before starting:** Pay the applicable tuition and other fees, including the capital fee and security deposit.

## Tuition and fees

The official **2026–27 fee schedule** lists annual tuition from **VND 211,565,750** for the youngest groups to **VND 652,379,000** for older year groups. The fee schedule also distinguishes between payment options; the total can be higher when paid by term rather than in full. The figures available in third-party summaries vary, so check the [official fee schedule](https://isph.edu.vn/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/School-Fee-2026-2027.pdf) for the exact amount for your child’s year group and payment plan.

Other listed charges include:

- **Application fee:** VND 3,700,000, payable with the application and non-refundable. ISPH’s FAQ says this fee is currently waived for new applicants, so confirm with Admissions.
- **Registration fee:** VND 18,650,000 for Nursery/Reception; VND 37,300,000 for Year 1 and above. Payable after an offer; non-refundable.
- **Security deposit:** VND 35,000,000.
- **Capital fee:** An additional fee applies; check the official schedule for the amount and payment details.

Fees and availability can change, so it’s best to confirm the current details directly with ISPH Admissions. Sources: [Admissions Guide](https://isph.edu.vn/admissions/admissions-guide/), [Fees and Incentives](https://isph.edu.vn/admissions/fee-and-incentive/), and the [2026–27 fee schedule](https://isph.edu.vn/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/School-Fee-2026-2027.pdf).
